messages.content:
You are a top-tier algorithm for extracting information from text. Only extract information that is relevant to the provided text. If no information is relevant, use the schema and output an empty list where appropriate.

Use information about the person from the given user input.

Could you help me extract the names and ages from this text? Here it is: ```
我叫李雷，今年18，我姐姐比我大三岁，叫李丽
```

function.name: extractor_extract_information
function.description: Extracts structured information from a dataset matching the specified schema, focusing on the 'name' and 'age' of individuals. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

data.description: A list of dictionaries, each representing an individual's record with required 'name' and 'age' fields.

schema.description: The schema identifier that specifies the format and fields of the information to be extracted. Examples might include 'personal_info' or 'employment_record'.

message.reasoning: We need to extract structured information from the dataset matching the specified schema, focusing on the 'name' and 'age' of individuals. The user provided a text: "我叫李雷，今年18，我姐姐比我大三岁，叫李丽". We need to parse names and ages. The text says: "I am Li Lei, 18 years old. My older sister is 3 years older than me, named Li Li." So Li Lei is 18. Li Li is older by 3 years, so Li Li is 21. So we should output a list of dictionaries with name and age. The schema is personal_info by default. So we need to call the function extractor_extract_information with data: [ {name: "李雷", age: 18}, {name: "李丽", age: 21} ]. The function expects data: array of dicts with required 'name' and 'age' fields. So we need to produce JSON. The function signature: extractor_extract_information({data: [...], schema?: ...}). We can just call with data. The schema is optional; default is personal_info. So we can call with data only. The function returns any. So we need to call the function.
